summary: Dan Osborn told The American Prospect in April 2024 he believed Israel's response to Hamas was justified while expressing concern about casualties. By March 2026 he had received and publicly touted an endorsement from an anti-Israel group, and Vote for Peace rates him an Ally. His platform opposes reckless foreign wars and Iran spending but lacks specific Palestine or Israel-aid language. The 2024 justifying statement sits in tension with the later pro-Palestine endorsements.
